name: Do I need to move out during repiping?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to move out during repiping?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, homeowners do not need to move out during a whole-home repiping project. We work to maintain water access for as much of the process as possible, although there will be periods when the water supply needs to be temporarily shut off, typically for a few hours. We coordinate closely with you to schedule these interruptions and ensure you are informed of the daily work plan. Our goal is to complete the project with minimal inconvenience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowners typically do not need to move out during repiping; we maintain water access and minimize temporary shut-offs.
